points: None of your 22 live ads shows a proof number, so a worker has no hard fact to judge you by. Collect one real count, such as workers placed or shifts filled, and open the next batch with it.
0 of 18 copy ads mention an offer, so an undecided worker has no reason to tap today. Give new workers one reason to act, such as a first shift bonus, and put it in line one of three new ads.

Your 18 copy ads open with 8 different stories, and the biggest one leads 4 of them, so no single pitch gets tested enough to learn from. Pick the two strongest openings and build the next batch from them, three variations each.

Three of your ads have run 60 days or more, so they already work. Build three more variations of the oldest winner, changing the city and the shift type while keeping its core angle, so the proven idea reaches new workers.
